lines.trans: Andrea, Xavier Beauvois said yes!
That is not true! That is amazing!
Of course yes, he loves the project.
I am so proud of you, my love.
Do we meet at home tonight?
Yes, at home, it is much simpler.
We are going to celebrate properly both together.
Well done my darling, you deserve this success.
Kisses all over, see you in a bit!
See you soon, I love you deeply.
Right, where were we with our file?
Do not forget our housewarming party!
I will be on time, promised!
Perfect, I am preparing champagne for us!
